integrity: Universal trace and determinant identities are proved in RESULT.md; verify.py runs symbolic checks and exact rational examples. Historical priority is based on inspected accessible literature and is not independently established.
limitations: Deterministic low-density two-stage projections with zero juvenile stasis, three strictly positive season-specific survival and fertility triplets, and a common multiplicative fertility parameter; does not establish nonlinear persistence or random extinction risks.
title: The oriented-volume law for three-season juvenile–adult persistence
